posts.author: Zattersmox
posts.body:
Been a lurker for a long time. Used to use XP but switched to MZ, and long before that I was using 2k3 and this other really short lived maker called 'network RPG maker 2000'.
I use 3D models to render sprites and backgrounds for most of my little unfinished projects, creating the characters in Daz3D and exporting to Blender for animation and posing. In this way I also like to create sprites of popular characters IE Spyro the Dragon or whatever. I'll probably post some soon.
Peace.
